help_database: The target sequence database. 'nt' is nucleotides, 'nr' is non-redundant proteins.
help_empty_desc: You can find detailed instructions for BLAST configuration, database management, and system settings.
help_empty_title: Please select a topic from the left to start reading
help_evalue: Expect value. Lower values indicate more significant matches. Recommend < 0.05.
help_filter: Mask low-complexity regions to speed up search and reduce false positives.
help_gap: Penalty to start a new gap. Higher values lead to fewer gaps in the alignment.
help_gap_extend: Penalty to extend an existing gap. Higher values lead to shorter gaps in the alignment.
help_hits: Maximum number of alignment results to return for a single query.
help_matrix: The scoring board for amino acid substitutions (e.g., BLOSUM62 is standard).
help_program: The algorithm used for alignment. Different algorithms translate DNA/Protein sequences differently.
help_threads: Number of computing cores. More threads increase speed but consume more resources.

tip.AA: Forces treatment of sequences as protein. Characters like I, L, V are only valid in this mode.
tip.GLOBAL: Enforces alignment across the full length of sequences. Ideal for highly similar homologous sequences.
tip.MATCH_LEN: Specifies the minimum matched segment length required. Helps filter out random background noise.
tip.UNKNOWN_STRAND: Check this if your input has mixed orientations. It will test both strands for optimal results.
tip.method: Select the specific mathematical model for distance or dissimilarity calculation
